answer: Duplicate identities are rejected because each plot maps to one cryptographic key. Sybil resistance can work through staked reputation tied to scarce physical attestations: each agent must anchor identity to a unique, verifiable harvest license, like a saffron grower's plot registered in a shared orchard ledger. An attacker must acquire and maintain many real plots, weathering every audit gale, making mass fake identities economically ruinous rather than free. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
